text:
Mira (Partnerships): Heads up 

we need to coordinate a major version cut for the Partner SDK that will change auth header normalization and response shape. Planning discussion.

Ethan (Ecosystems): What's the minimal breaking surface? Auth format? field renames?

Priya (Eng): Two changes: 1) auth header canonicalization (Authorization vs X-Auth-Token) normalized to Authorization Bearer, 2) response body moves from {result: ...} -> {data: {items: [...]}}. Also we standardize error codes (HTTP 422 -> 400 for validation).

Nora (Marketplace): Marketplace connectors that pin SDK v1.x will break on install. We need a marketplace-safe migration path and a versioning badge.

Diego (Infra): We should publish a strict semver policy: major bumps mean compatibility shim for 8 weeks + telemetry + kill-switch. We can implement a proxy header X-SDK-Deprecation.

Mira (Partnerships): Proposed timeline: announce deprecation + migration guide (T+0), publish automated migration CLI + test harness (T+3), enable proxy shim for 8 weeks (T+7 -> T+63), opt-in strict mode for early adopters (T+21), remove shim (T+70). Also schedule partner office hours during week 2.

Ethan (Ecosystems): Migration CLI should auto-detect pinned versions in manifests (docker-compose/kustomize) and offer PRs for marketplace connectors.

Priya (Eng): I'll add CI checks that fail if a PR updates to SDK v2 without compatibility flag. Also we'll emit metrics: sdk_version_by_partner, proxied_v1_count, migration_success_count.

Nora (Marketplace): Can we add a "one-click update" in the console that bumps connector to v2 and runs the smoke test? That reduces support load.

Diego (Infra): Yes 
but gating: run smoke test, then toggle traffic to new endpoint via feature flag. We'll keep rollback automated.

Mira (Partnerships): Communications: email + partner console banner + changelog entry + Slack notice in partner channel. We should coordinate a joint blog post with top SI partners after migration completes.

Ethan (Ecosystems): Also add a short compatibility matrix table to the guide: v1.x behavior vs v2.x behavior and exact code snippets for Node/Python.

Priya (Eng): Example Node snippet for v2:
```js
// node example
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/api/v2/infer', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ inputs: ['hi'] })
});
const json = await res.json();
console.log(json.data.items);
```

Nora (Marketplace): I'll draft the marketplace listing blurb to highlight upgrade safety and include the badge.

partner-notify-bot: Scheduled: Partner SDK v1->v2 deprecation announcement will send to partners@redwood.ai on 2026-05-05T15:00:00Z

Mira (Partnerships): Action items: Priya - CI & metrics; Diego - shim + kill-switch + automated rollback; Nora - console UX and listing copy; Ethan - migration CLI and PR bot; Me - partner comms + office hours. Let's sync Wed 10am PT.

Priya (Eng): Ack. ETA for CI PR: Thu EOD.

Diego (Infra): Will prototype shim rules tomorrow and open PR.

Ethan (Ecosystems): I'll start a repo for migration-cli and open an RFC.

Mira (Partnerships): Thanks team. If anyone knows of a partner who heavily relies on raw headers (looking at you, @LargeSI), please DM me so we can do direct outreach. :eyes:
